decisions.reason: Changing the framing of the Page 32 photograph does not alter font type, font size, or the unresolved bolding treatment.
The source concerns a photograph on Page 32, not the one-page cover letter, signature insertion, or relocation of the letter's overflow photographs.
The Page 32 photograph framing change does not modify the background treatment required for the listed special pages.
The source requests a localized photo-framing adjustment and does not change the full-document layout coverage, layout approach, or spacing policy.
Making the tree more prominent in one photograph does not change the Blue Mesa brand identity, logo, or color requirements.
The Page 32 photograph adjustment has no necessary effect on inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
The requested wider photograph view does not establish any change to the 34-page limit or the document spacing policy.
The photo-framing revision does not affect Canva editing access, ownership, or asset licensing constraints.
Adjusting a photograph on Page 32 does not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
The photograph-framing request does not affect the biography count, affiliation, insertion method, or biography source.
The Page 32 image adjustment does not change the required tables, budget sheet, replacement count, or approved table source.
The localized photo-framing change does not modify the final PDF format, print readiness, email submission, or export-quality requirements.
